home.noBudget: No budget set for this month.
home.emptyBody: Add your first expense, or scan a receipt with Raseedhu.

expense.invalidRate: Enter an exchange rate, for example 15.42.

scan.title: Raseedhu
scan.subtitle: Photograph a receipt. We fill in the details for you to check.
scan.manual: Add an expense without a photo
scan.noScans: You've used all {{limit}} free scans this month. More on the 1st. You can still add expenses yourself.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera is off. Allow it in Settings, or pick a photo from your gallery.
scan.unreadable: Couldn't read this receipt. Try a new photo in good light, or enter it yourself. This scan wasn't counted.
scan.offline: No connection. Your photo is kept, so try again when you're online. This scan wasn't counted.

confirm.title: Check and save
confirm.intro: Check each detail. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.
confirm.lowConfidence: We're not sure about this one.
confirm.mismatchTitle: The items don't add up to the total
confirm.mismatchBody: Items {{items}} + GST {{gst}} = {{expected}}, but the receipt total is {{total}}. Check the amounts below.
confirm.matchOk: Items and GST match the total.
confirm.leaveBody: This receipt hasn't been saved yet.
confirm.otherMonth: This receipt is from {{month}}, so it will be saved under that month. Change the date below if that's wrong.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hint: Set a limit to see how you're doing. It applies from this month on.

reports.title: Reports
reports.empty: No spending in this month yet.
reports.debtFromSalaryNote: Taken before your pay arrived, so it isn't counted as spending.

more.title: More
more.about: Kharadhu helps you see where your money goes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ratesNote: Rates don't update by themselves. We keep the last one you entered.
settings.biometric: Lock the app with Face ID or fingerprint
settings.biometricUnavailable: Set up Face ID or a fingerprint on your phone first.
settings.keepPhotosNote: Photos are deleted after reading by default. Only the details stay.
settings.pinNote: Unlock with a PIN when Face ID or fingerprint isn't available.
settings.hideAmountsNote: Shows •••• instead of money. The eye on Home toggles it.
settings.thaanaKeyboardNote: Type Dhivehi on the Kharadhu keyboard. Turn off to use your phone's own keyboard.

debts.title: Debt-free plan
debts.amanah: A debt is an amanah, a trust. Repaying it promptly is kind to you and to them.
debts.neverPays: At this amount the balance isn't going down. A bit more each month would fix that.
debts.noDebtsBody: Add a debt to see a plan for paying it off. There's no rush.
debts.snowballHint: Clear small debts quickly and roll their payments forward.
debts.monthlyHint: What you pay yourself each month. Loans taken from salary are separate.
debts.raised: Increased to cover your minimum payments ({{amount}}).
debts.interestNote: Interest-bearing debts are marked so you can choose what to clear first. Guidance, not a ruling.
debts.inRegister: Include in my register for my family
debts.inRegisterNote: Trusted people see it only after a confirmed passing.
debts.notesHint: Please don't write account numbers or passwords here.
debts.deleteBody: Its payment history will be deleted too.
debts.quickStartNote: Typical rates and minimums. Check them against your statement and edit what differs.
debts.currencyUsdNote: Balance and minimum are in USD. You pay in MVR, converted at the rate you enter.
debts.currencyMvrNote: Choose USD for a card billed in dollars.
debts.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once payments are recorded.
debts.minFloorHint: The least that is ever due.
debts.minAmountHint: Leave empty if there is none.
debts.minRule: {{pct}} of the balance, never less than {{floor}}
debts.extraHere: Your plan puts the extra money here this month.
debts.amountHint: Start from the suggested amount, or type any amount.
debts.tooMuchPaid: That is more than is owed.
debts.defaultRate: Usual rate {{rate}}. Enter your bank's rate to change it.
debts.usdCounted: Debts in USD are counted at MVR {{rate}} per dollar.
debts.payExtra: Put the extra here: pay about {{amount}} this month
debts.goodwillNote: Minimum only, until your other debts are clear.

orderHint.snowball: Smallest balance first. Each cleared debt frees its payment for the next.
orderHint.avalanche: Highest interest first. It costs the least in interest overall.

debts.needDueDay: Enter the day of the month it is taken.
debts.fixedLoanNote: MIB adds its profit up front, so there is no rate. Enter the total left to pay and the monthly instalment from your statement.
debts.autoDeductedNote: The lender takes the instalment before your pay arrives. We record it each month for you, so you never enter it twice.
debts.autoLine: {{amount}} a month, deducted from your salary
debts.autoPayNote: Instalments are recorded for you each month. Add a payment only if you pay extra.

giving.title: Giving
giving.intro: Giving is a gentle habit. Every amount counts.
giving.goalReached: You've reached your goal this month. May it be accepted.
giving.recipientHint: Private. Only you can see this.
giving.deleteBody: The matching expense is removed too.
giving.countsNote: Sadaqah and jariyah count toward your goal. Zakat and obligations are kept apart.

zakat.title: Zakat date and goal
zakat.dateHint: The Hijri date your zakat year ends, if you keep one.
zakat.adjustHint: Moon sighting can differ by a day. Pick the date that matches yours.
zakat.reminderNote: A week before and on the day. Never shows amounts.
zakat.permissionDenied: Notifications are off. Allow them in your phone's settings.
zakat.guidance: Zakat depends on your situation. Ask a trusted scholar about yours. Kharadhu only helps you remember.
zakat.notifWeek: A gentle reminder: your zakat date is a week away.
zakat.notifDay: A gentle reminder: your zakat date is today.

register.title: Wasiyyah & Amanah
register.intro: A private list for your family: debts, money owed to you, giving still to do, trusts and wishes. Nothing is shared while you're well. Never write passwords, PINs or card numbers here.
register.ready: You're ready. Nothing is shared unless your trusted people confirm.
register.itemsEmpty: Nothing yet. Debts from the Debt-free plan are included automatically if you chose that.
register.detailsHint: Encrypted. Please don't write passwords, PINs or card numbers.
register.honest: Private and encrypted. As our privacy policy explains, a Kharadhu administrator could technically access it.

contacts.title: People you trust
contacts.intro: Choose up to three people. They see nothing now. If you can't be reached for a long time, they're asked to check on you, and your list opens only when they confirm.
contacts.revokeBody: They'll no longer be asked, and can't see anything.
contacts.name: Their name
contacts.inviterName: How should you appear to them?
contacts.consent: I agree that Kharadhu shares this person's name and email with its email service (Resend) to message them, and that they'll be told why they were chosen.
contacts.shareText: {{who}} would like you to be someone they trust in Kharadhu. Please open this link: {{link}}
contacts.linkNote: Works for 7 days, once only. Send it to them yourself.
contacts.appUrlMissing: Invites aren't available right now. Please try again later.

release.title: Check-ins and away mode
release.intro: If you don't open Kharadhu for a long time, we email you twice. If there's still no answer, your trusted people are asked to check on you. Silence alone never opens anything.

state.active: You're active. Nothing is being asked of anyone.
state.quiet: We checked in. Open the app to say you're okay.
state.second_checkin: We've checked in twice. Open the app to say you're okay.
state.contacts_asked: Your trusted people have been asked to check on you. Opening the app stops this.
state.released: Your list has been opened to the people you trust.

release.awayNote: Travelling, on Hajj or Umrah, or in hospital? Pause check-ins for up to 90 days.

events.release_blocked: An attempt to open it was refused
events.answer_withdrawn: A trusted person changed their mind

accept.title: A request from someone you may know
accept.body: {{who}} asks you to be a trusted person. If they can't be reached for a long time, you may be asked to check on them. You'd see their list only if you and others confirm they have passed away. You can say no.
accept.accepted: Thank you. You're now their trusted person. Nothing is needed from you now.
accept.declined: No problem. We've let them know you declined.
accept.expired: This invite has expired. Please ask them for a new one.
accept.used: This invite has already been used.
accept.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

contactSide.title: People who trust me
contactSide.intro: People who asked you to be their trusted person appear here, once they can't be reached. Sign in with the email they invited.
contactSide.none: No one needs anything from you right now.
contactSide.asked: {{who}} can't be reached. Please check on them if you can, then tell us.
contactSide.passedBody: Only choose this if you know they have passed away. Their list opens only when others confirm too, and they're told straight away.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.body: This deletes your account and everything in it: spending, debts, giving, register, trusted people and receipt photos. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.failed: Couldn't delete your account. Try again, or contact us.
deleteAccount.privacyMissing: The privacy policy isn't available right now. Try again later.

deleteInfo.title: Delete your Kharadhu account
deleteInfo.intro: You can delete your account and all your data yourself, anytime.
deleteInfo.step3: Choose Delete my account and type DELETE.
deleteInfo.what: This deletes your spending, debts, giving, register, trusted people and receipt photos. It can't be undone.
deleteInfo.help: Can't sign in? Email us from your account's address and we'll delete it for you.
deleteInfo.emailMissing: Contact details aren't available right now.
deleteInfo.signIn: Sign in here to delete it

webHome.body: This website is for trusted people and for deleting your account. For everything else, use the Kharadhu app.

trend.title: Last 6 months
trend.average: Average spending {{amount}} a month. Tap a month to see it.

onboarding.p1Body: Log spending in MVR in seconds, or photograph a receipt and let Raseedhu read it.
onboarding.p2Title: Pay debts down. Give with intention.
onboarding.p2Body: A calm plan to be debt-free, plus a place for your sadaqah and zakat.
onboarding.p3Body: Your debts and wishes stay private. They open to people you trust only if they confirm, never because of silence.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it, then come back and sign in.
checkEmail.tip: Can't find it? Look in your spam or junk folder.
checkEmail.resendIn: You can send it again in {{seconds}} seconds
checkEmail.failed: We couldn't send it. Please try again in a minute.

setup.title: Let's get you started
setup.body: One quick thing. You can change it any time.
setup.budgetHint: What do you plan to spend each month? We'll show how you're doing.
setup.tip: Tip: tap the round button at the bottom to scan a receipt.
setup.whoBody: You can change this later in More.
setup.together: Me and my partner or family
setup.whoNote: Shared entries go in one pot you all see. Everything else stays private.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Pick a password you have not used before.
reset.done: Password changed. Open the Kharadhu app and sign in.
reset.expired: This link expired or was already used. Ask for a new reset link in the app.
reset.none: Open the reset link from your email to choose a new password.

foreign.splitHelp: Paid in more than one currency? Add one entry for each.
foreign.keepNote: Turn on if you haven't exchanged it yet. Convert to MVR later.
foreign.heldMvr: About {{amount}} at the rate you were paid
foreign.gain: {{amount}} more than at the rate you were paid
foreign.loss: {{amount}} less than at the rate you were paid
foreign.even: Same as the rate you were paid
foreign.tooMuch: That's more than you have in this currency.
foreign.explain: Exchanging money doesn't change your income or spending totals.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: Kharadhu closed unexpectedly. Your records are safe. Sorry about that.
crash.thanks: Thank you. We have your report.
crash.privacy: Sends what you wrote and technical details. Not your records.

edit.deleteExpenseBody: It will be removed from your reports and budget.
edit.deleteIncomeBody: It will be removed from your income totals.
edit.deleteGivingNote: The giving record is removed too.
edit.shareBody: Everyone in the household will see it, and it leaves your own records.
edit.privateBody: Only you will see it, and it leaves the shared pot.

pin.mismatch: The PINs did not match. Choose again.
pin.forgotBody: This signs you out and removes the app lock on this phone. Sign in again to continue. Your data stays safe.

commit.title: Monthly commitments
commit.empty: Monthly gifts, like sponsoring a student, show here until you stop them.
commit.markedPaid: Marked as paid for this month
commit.intro: Shows here every month until you stop it. Mark it paid each month.
commit.recipientHint: A school, mosque or person. Private.
commit.noteHint: For example, sponsorship of a student.
commit.dayHint: A day from 1 to 28 of each month.
commit.stopBody: It stops showing each month. Past payments stay in your history.

about.title: About Kharadhu
about.tagline: Know where your money goes, in your own language.
about.budget: Tracks spending and income against a monthly budget, in rufiyaa.
about.debts: A plan to be debt-free, with a suggested payment each month.
about.giving: Tracks sadaqah and zakat, including monthly gifts.
about.register: A private Wasiyyah and Amanah register for people you trust.
about.raseedhu: Raseedhu reads receipts with AI. You check every detail before saving.
about.private: Your records are yours. No ads, no tracking, and your data is never sold. Delete your account and everything in it anytime in Settings.
about.notAdvice: Guidance and reminders only. Not financial, legal or religious advice, and no rulings.
about.linksSoon: Terms and contact details will appear here.

offline.banner: No internet. Showing what was last saved.
offline.cantSave: No internet, so this wasn't saved. Try again online.
offline.someFailed_one: {{count}} saved item could not be uploaded and was dropped.
offline.someFailed_other: {{count}} saved items could not be uploaded and were dropped.
offline.signOutWaiting_one: {{count}} saved item hasn't uploaded. Signing out loses it.
offline.signOutWaiting_other: {{count}} saved items haven't uploaded. Signing out loses them.

notFound.title: This page isn't available
notFound.body: The link may be old or the page moved. Your records are fine.

loadError.title: We couldn't load this
loadError.body: Check your connection and try again.

pools.title: Money pools
pools.intro: A pool with friends or family: everyone puts in the same amount each month, and each person takes the pot in turn.
pools.emptyBody: Add one to keep track of what you put in each month and when it's your turn.
pools.name: Pool name
pools.membersHint: Used to work out your pot.
pools.payoutHint: The month you take the pot, like 03/2027.
pools.stopBody: It stops showing each month. What you paid stays in your history.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.intro: Rent you pay or receive, bills, subscriptions. Each date is added for you, or waits for you to confirm.
recurring.emptyBody: Add rent, a bill or a subscription once and it's added every time it falls due.

nameHint.income: For example, Flat rent from tenant.

recurring.startsHint: It repeats from this date. A past date adds the missed ones.

autoNote.expense: Added on the day, so you don't have to.
autoNote.income: Off by default: you confirm each one when the money arrives.

recurring.stopBody: It stops adding new ones. Everything already added stays.
recurring.name: Name

household.title: Household
household.intro: Share an account with your partner or family. Anything you mark Shared goes in one pot everyone sees. Everything else stays private to you.
household.joinNote: Ask the person who started it for a code.
household.needNames: Enter your name and a household name.
household.needCode: Enter your name and the code.
household.badCode: That code isn't valid, or it has expired or been used.
household.inviteNote: Works once, for 7 days. Send it to them yourself.
household.shareText: Join our household "{{name}}" on Kharadhu with this code: {{code}}
household.inviteFailed: Couldn't make a code. The household may be full.
household.removeBody: They lose access to the shared pot. Entries they added stay.
household.leaveBody: You lose access to the shared pot. Your own private records are not affected.
household.paidBy: Added by {{name}}. Anyone in the household can change it.
household.deleteBody: It's removed for everyone in the household.

mode.coupleNote: For two people. Shared spending is split in half, and you see who owes whom.
mode.householdNote: For a family or flatmates, any number of people. You see what each person paid.

household.coupleFull: A couple has two people, and this one is full.
household.tooManyForCouple: A couple has two people. Remove someone first.

split.title: Hissa Foshi
split.intro: Share costs with friends: a trip, a flat, a dinner. Add what each person paid and we work out who owes whom. Your friends don't need the app.
split.emptyBody: Make a group, add the people, then add costs as they happen.
split.peopleHint: Add everyone else in the group.
split.needPeople: Add at least one other person.
split.settleNote: The fewest payments that clear everything.
split.deleteCostBody: Balances are worked out again without it.
split.deleteGroupBody: This deletes the group with all its costs and payments.
split.sumWrong: The split doesn't add up to the total.

typeHint.percent: Type each person's percent. It must make 100.
typeHint.shares: Type shares, like 1 and 2. 2 pays twice 1.

split.hasApp: Has the app. Sees this group live.
split.nameOnly: Name only. Follows along with the day sheet.
split.theirEmailHint: When they sign in to Kharadhu with this email, they can join.
split.inviteSaved: Invited. They will see it when they sign in.
split.removeAccessBody: They stop seeing this group. Their name and costs stay.
split.peopleNote: Friends with the app see the group live and can add costs. For others, share the day sheet.
split.leaveGroupBody: You stop seeing this group. Your name and costs stay for the others.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.needsReview: The items didn't add up to the total when this was saved.
receipt.noItems: No items were saved with this receipt.

plus.title: Kharadhu Plus
plus.intro: Everything you rely on stays free. Plus is for people who scan a lot, share with more people, or keep long records.
plus.soon: Subscriptions open soon. Thank you for your patience.
plus.failed: The purchase didn't go through. You were not charged.
plus.priceNote: The App Store or Google Play shows the price when you subscribe. You can cancel any time in your store account.
plus.freeBody: Adding entries by hand, budgets and charts, the debt-free plan, zakat, sadaqah and giving, couple sharing, working offline, the PIN lock, and {{free}} Raseedhu scans a month.

benefit.export: Monthly summary as PDF or CSV

benefitNote.photos: Free scans keep only what was read, not the photo.
benefitNote.export: A tidy page to share or keep.
benefitNote.household: Free: you and one other person.
benefitNote.history: Free: this month and the five before.

reason.scans: You've used this month's {{free}} free scans. Plus gives {{plus}}.
reason.photos: Keeping receipt photos is part of Plus.
reason.export: The monthly summary is part of Plus.
reason.household: A household of three or more is part of Plus. You and one other person are free.
reason.history: Reports older than {{months}} months are part of Plus.
reason.split: You have {{groups}} Hissa Foshi groups. More are part of Plus.
reason.recurring: You have {{recurring}} recurring items. More are part of Plus.

plus.more: Scans, people and history for more
plus.storeCode: I have an App Store or Google Play offer code
plus.codeInvalid: That code isn't valid, or it has ended or been used.
plus.codeTooMany: Too many tries. Wait an hour and try again.
plus.codeAlready: You already have Plus through your subscription. The code was not used.

sheet.title: Day sheet
sheet.heading: Costs and who owes whom
sheet.footer: Made with Kharadhu. Amounts include everything up to the end of this day.
sheet.unavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
sheet.failed: Couldn't make the picture. Try sharing as text.
sheet.yourNameHint: So people reading it know who "Me" is.

rule.intro: A simple way to split your income: 50% for needs, 30% for wants, and 20% for saving and paying off debt.
rule.useNote: Shows on Home, Budget and Reports once you have added income this month.
rule.noIncome: Add this month's income to see your 50/30/20 targets.
rule.categoriesNote: Giving and money pools count as savings. Change any category here.

ious.title: IOUs
ious.more: Money lent or borrowed between people
ious.intro: Money you lent or borrowed. Record payments as they happen and see where it stands.
ious.emptyBody: Lent someone money, or borrowed some? Add it here and tick it off as it is paid back.
ious.emailHint: When they sign in to Kharadhu with this email they can see the IOU and add payments. Nothing is sent.
ious.needEmailForBoth: Add their email to remind them too.

nudge.title: Reminders
nudge.meNote: A reminder on your phone 2 days before it is due, then every 3 days until it is paid.
nudge.bothNote: Reminds you, and emails {{name}} on the same days until it is paid.
nudge.bothOnlyLent: Reminding them is only for money you lent.

msg.due: Hi {{name}}, a gentle reminder about {{what}}, due {{date}}. Thank you!
msg.open: Hi {{name}}, a gentle reminder about {{what}}. Thank you!

ious.notifBody: You have an IOU that needs a look.
ious.removePaymentBody: What is owed goes back up by this amount.
ious.deleteBody: It is removed for both of you, with its payments.
ious.leaveBody: You stop seeing it. It stays with the person who made it.
ious.peopleNote: Everyone you make an IOU with is saved here, so you can pick them next time.
ious.removePersonBody: They disappear from this list. IOUs already made with them stay.
